newsitem.title: NORWAY: Dyno in U.S. computer joint venture.
newsitem.headline: Dyno in U.S. computer joint venture.

text.p: Norway's Dyno Industrier ASA said on Monday it had started negotiating the establishment of a joint venture with the U.S. company Orchid Biocomputer Inc to develop biocomputers.
It said in a statement that biocomputers were the next generation of clinical laboratory instruments for diagnostic use in hospital laboratories.
Dyno said Dynal AS, part of the corporation's Division Particles, was negotiating the joint venture.

"If negotiations are successful the new joint venture will represent a major development in Dyno's strategy in the diagnostics market. Funding for the new company is expected to come from international financial markets," it said.
Orchid is a spin-off from the David Sarnoff Research Center in Princeton, New Jersey, Dyno said.
